goal: My research aims to build positive, meaningful relationships between scientists and the public, and to promote evidence-based communication that not only deepens public understanding of science but also inspires engagement and interest in it.

facts.label: Focus
facts.text: How digital spaces and emerging technologies shape the public communication and understanding of science

facts.label: Methods
facts.text: Survey experiments, surveys, content analysis, and semi-structured interviews

facts.label: Background
facts.text: Trained as both a chemist and a science journalist, bringing an interdisciplinary lens to the work

funding: National Science Foundation Doctoral Dissertation Research Improvement Grant, Decision, Risk and Management Science
University of Michigan Rackham Predoctoral Fellowship
